description: This file defines a static utility class for testing purposes, specifically to ensure that the storage emulator is not used during certain tests. It contains a method that checks the data connection string for indicators of emulator usage and throws an exception if such indicators are found.

classes.name: StorageEmulatorUtilities
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods related to storage emulator testing.

methods.name: EnsureEmulatorIsNotUsed
methods.description: Checks if the data connection string indicates usage of the storage emulator and throws an exception to skip tests if so.
